summary: Verified both estimates against the paper after reading all 77,924 characters of the markdown conversion through the end of the references. The PDF has 13 pages and no appendix or referenced separate supplement. Checked the cited Table 1 directly in PDF p. 7, supporting methods and counts on pp. 1 and 4-6, and exclusions on pp. 7-8 and 10-11; also inspected Figure 1 and the results prose by rendering PDF pp. 5 and 7 in memory. All recorded arm counts, means, and standard deviations match the correct creative-writing rows. The outcome and contrast codes, timing, AI availability, direction, and between-person interpretation are supported. The participant unit, SD level, and se_basis describe the reported student-level analysis. The peer arm contains 38 students in 19 pairs; its unresolved score dependence is already documented in the extraction and remains a limitation for pooling. No pairwise numerical tests, effect sizes, intervals, or combined contrast counts are printed, so their null values are appropriate. Both eligible contrasts on the total creativity score are included. Self-reports, baseline scores, unreported rubric subscores, correlations, AI-arm-only interaction descriptions, and the non-AI comparison are appropriately excluded. No extraction errors or missing eligible estimates were found.
